statement: Every fixture listed here is SYNTHETIC: hand-written for testing software behavior. None is PoB output, a live provider response, or a gameplay measurement, and none may be cited as evidence about PoE 2 mechanics.

fixtures.author: P00-T02
fixtures.description: Minimal hand-written PoB2 Huntress with no socket groups, no passives and no items; loads successfully and its FullDPS is a legitimate zero.
fixtures.caveat: Hand-written against the element names observed in PoB2 export files. Not produced by PoB and not a real character.

fixtures.author: P00-T02
fixtures.caveat: Invalid on purpose. Never repair it in place; add a new fixture instead.

fixtures.caveat: Invented payoff numbers; models no PoE 2 content.

fixtures.caveat: Invented durations and damage; models no PoE 2 skill.

fixtures.author: P00-T02
fixtures.description: Trade-API-shaped item carrying every modifier array convert_trade_item normalizes.
fixtures.caveat: Field names mirror bootstrap.lua's reads; no live trade response was fetched. Mod text is invented.

fixtures.author: P01-T01
fixtures.description: Valid and invalid SourceDocument, AcquisitionResult, PatchProfile and GameCatalog examples, plus the original bytes behind the fixture source.
fixtures.caveat: Hand-authored against contracts.md. Recorded content hashes (item_hash, build_hash, cache_key, manifest_hash) are re-derived by the P01 tests, so an identity-projection change fails there rather than drifting silently. No identifier, number or text in it names real PoE 2 content.
